description_sq:
Shitet 2+1 me 2 tualete te bollshme dhe ballkon.
I pershtatshem per banim dhe investim.
Ky apartament eshte investuar kohet e fundit dhe eshte bere me investim cilesor.
Akses i lehte ne rruge kryesore , transport urban, shkolla, markete dhe sherbime te tjera.
Disponon certifikate pronesie!
Disponon dhe post parkimi me cmim ekstra
description_en: For sale 2+1 with 2 spacious toilets and a balcony. Suitable for residence and investment. This apartment has recently been invested and it was made with quality investment. Easy access to the main road, urban transport, schools, markets and other services. It has certificates of ownership! There is also a parking post at an extra cost
